held_out_family.name: cladder
held_out_family.selection_reason: authoritative executable SCM family already frozen before any L1 result

floor_semantics.do_everything: for an intervention, set every graph variable to the intervention value; for identity, return the factual state unchanged
floor_semantics.random_init: derive every predicted binary variable deterministically from SHA-256(seed, factual state, target, intervention value)
floor_semantics.evaluation: validation states only; no training, checkpoint, or test access

commutation_instruction.rule: use the first observed same-graph different-target command; when the held-out family exposes only one observed intervention target per graph, synthesize a law-only command for the first other graph slot at the same value

last_write_instruction.rule: use the first observed same-graph opposite-value command; when absent, synthesize a law-only command for the same target at the opposite binary value

law_partner_wording: fixed raw command text without task paraphrase augmentation; paraphrase augmentation remains enabled for supervised base rows
